svg.title: EP2 C4 AREA 26
svg.desc: Seabed forces dangerous split play. Finish each group's mechanisms and pickups before confirming the advance. Use the source-numbered rooms as the route order; colored symbols identify switches, barriers, warps and fixed pickups.
